observations: RAW: 980 rows (70 tasks x14 pipeline-rule combos) with zero harness errors; 40 alias-OOD pooled (30 orthogonal header/body/auth x10 +10 mixed), 12 exact, 12 no-applicable, 6 empty.

OBSERVATION verbatim manipulation check: Under RULE-VERBATIM, all 7 verbatim pipelines plus exact baseline achieve 0/40=0.0 correct on alias-OOD pooled Wilson [0.0,0.0876] upper 0.0876 <=0.15, confirming parent 39/40 0.975 was reconstruction artifact requiring adopt-any-key; leak 0/40 held-out 0/9 mixed 0/10 verified.

OBSERVATION correct-family: Under RULE-CORRECTFAMILY, pooled alias-OOD correct is 21/40=0.525 for B-FLAT-TFIDF-K5-CF, B-FLAT-EMBED-K5-CF, H-HIERARCHICAL-CF, H-WEBAPI-CF (identical), 18/40=0.45 for B-RANDOM-K5-CF, 0/40 for B-EXACT-MATCH (kernel exact). All CF pipelines identical except random slightly lower (McNemar p=1.0 vs flat).

OBSERVATION coverage: Under CF, recall@k coverage is 0.55 for all pipelines (22/40) vs verbatim 0.0; best flat vs hierarchical vs webapi identical, coverage gain 0.0 CI [0.0,0.0] p=1.0 for both hierarchical and WebAPI vs best flat (TFIDF-K5-CF). Density gain -0.105 (hier 1.385 vs flat 1.49) p=0.0 significant negative, not positive.

OBSERVATION per-family CF: fam1 body 10/10=1.0, fam2 auth 9/10=0.9, fam0 header 2/10=0.2, fam3 mixed 0/10=0.0 for all CF pipelines; held-out 9 subset 7/9=0.777 for flat and hierarchical/webapi; mixed failure drives pooled false 10/40=0.25.

OBSERVATION calibration: Alias-OOD CF ECE 0.257 for hierarchical/webapi, 0.263 for flat TFIDF, 0.261 for embed, all >0.15 threshold; exact-match CF 11/12=0.917 (one gated UNKNOWN) vs verbatim 12/12=1.0; no-applicable precision 1.0; confidence std 0.274-0.284 >0.05 varies, not constant.

OBSERVATION controls: PC-EXACT-MATCH pass (all >=0.90, false 0), PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH non-empty 1.0 but distinct win 0.475 components (marginal) vs 0.65 types, PC-WEBAPI-INDEX-BUILT 84 themes 45 components 168 episodes, PC-VERBATIM-CHECK pass, NCs all pass, no oracle leak.
validity_notes: Representation loss: Synthetic orthogonal header/body/auth + mixed multi-channel aliasing with minimal derived dict (url, method, url_path, url_query, url_segments, headers_observed, body_observed) only; no AX tree, no BrowserGym 1280x720 viewport, no DOM heterogeneity, no auth/session drift, no visual layout; claim bounded to this synthetic with correct-family gating, not live WebShop/ALFWorld/WebArena.

Registry expansion 8>k fix: per alias-OOD task registry expanded from parent 3 to 8 mechanisms (1 training +2 same-family +2 cross-family +2 mixed fragments +1 random) to make pool>k; task semantics byte-identical to parent tasks.json sha 4abf1487 for intents/expected_bounds, only distractors added; disclosed as valid design fix per handoff do_not_assume.

Correct-family implementation: candidate_families derived via template parsing of slot types (header if header slot, body if body slot, auth if ${perm} slot, query if query slot, path if path slot); observed_families derived from derived_context (header if non-standard header present, body if body_observed non-empty, query if url_query non-empty, auth if scope/permission key present); eligibility requires intersection non-empty; rewriting filtered to overlapping families only via channel_to_family mapping and alphabetically sorted single-adoption per family; no hidden_expected access verified.

Mixed multi-channel limitation: Mixed 10 tasks where alias spans header+body+query simultaneously require joint coverage; under correct-family single-base rewrite cannot invent cross-family keys, so mixed 0/10 false (partial) for all CF pipelines, driving pooled false 0.25 >0.15 and ECE 0.26 >0.15; hierarchical/WebAPI complementary selection still picks single base per task (adaptive k 2-5 but bind picks best single), not joint multi-candidate composition; S2/S4 failures reflect mixed composition, not retrieval failure for orthogonal families.

Calibration: ECE computed over 5 confidence bins with derived confidence (softmax temp 0.15 + jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80); bins 3 of 5 empty for verbatim, 2 empty for CF; ECE 0.257 exceeds 0.15 threshold, indicates miscalibration despite std>0.05; boostrap CI not computed for ECE.

Retrieval health marginal: distinct_components win 0.475 (<0.50) vs distinct_component_types win 0.65 (>=0.50); density gain negative -0.105 significant; hierarchical 84 themes identical to WebAPI 84 themes (same Jaccard 0.6 clustering on same 168 episodes), so WebAPI not distinct algorithm from hierarchical on this synthetic, endpoint terminology does not imply tool/API bypass.

Sample size: pooled alias-OOD N=40 meets minimum 32, orthogonal 30, mixed 10, exact 12, no-applicable 12, empty 6; 980 calls CPU-only <2 min, no Playwright/BrowserGym, no LLM tokens, deterministic seed 42.
No BrowserGym live substrate: per Director rationale, no new 1280x720 SPAs; live observation noise and residual-novelty economics not tested.

Embedding fallback: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 available via sentence-transformers, used for B-FLAT-EMBED-K5; TFIDF strong baseline identical results (0.525 tie) so embed vs TFIDF not discriminating under CF either.
unresolved: Whether live BrowserGym 1280x720 observation noise (WebShop/ALFWorld/WebArena) or richer DOM/AX representation breaks the 0.55 coverage ceiling and makes complementary discovery valuable vs single-candidate retrieval under correct-family gating.
Whether residual-novelty-tracked verification economics (pay cost of novelty only, freshness/UNKNOWN gating) provides higher work-compression leverage than retrieval diversity for alias-OOD tasks.

Whether alternative correct-family aggregation (multi-candidate joint rewriting for mixed tasks, or adaptive k with joint coverage) could solve mixed 0/10 under CF, or whether mixed composition requires explicit alias catalogs / server-side routing normalization.

Whether hierarchical vs flat vs webapi would separate on production Fetch/WebMCP endpoint discovery (OpenAPI specs, HATEOAS, auth-scope negotiation) where endpoint components span header+body+query+auth jointly and minimal derived dict is insufficient.

Whether ECE 0.257 >0.15 reflects confidence miscalibration that would transfer to live calibration, and whether different temperature or gating threshold (<0.80) would restore ECE<=0.15 without harming correct rate.
